text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-021 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-021 already tested a peak-hour surge incentive. It found that zone-level A/B overstated the lift because adjacent zones lost drivers, and it recommended market or switchback designs. The proposal does not cite or learn from this experiment.","evidence_quote":"Launch a surge incentive during peak hours across all markets and watch the dashboard.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-021, explain what differs this time, and adopt its learnings: use a market or switchback design and track neighboring zones."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Required pay/incentive guardrails absent","detail":"A surge incentive is a pay lever, so Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate and Cost Per Delivery are required guardrails. The proposal lists only neighbor-zone acceptance, which is vague and has no threshold.","evidence_quote":"Driver Acceptance Rate in neighboring zones: should not drop.","citations":["guardrail-standards#driver-pay-and-incentives"],"recommendation":"Add Driver Hourly Earnings, Driver Safety Incident Rate and Cost Per Delivery as guardrails with numeric stop thresholds. Also add On-Time Delivery Rate for neighbor zones."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No experiment plan; full rollout with dashboard monitoring","detail":"The proposal has no randomization, control, duration, MDE or power. A full rollout to all markets leaves no control group and cannot detect the interference EXP-021 found.","evidence_quote":"None. We will roll out to all markets and monitor the dashboard.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-021-peak-surge-incentive","experimentation-standards#guardrail-breach-policy"],"recommendation":"Design a market-level or switchback test with a control, at least 14 days of runtime, a stated MDE and power, and guardrail stop thresholds tied to the breach policy."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Driver pay change without recorded review","detail":"The incentive changes driver pay, which is a policy-controlled area. The proposal records no required review.","evidence_quote":"## Reviews And Dependencies\nNone.","citations":["guardrail-standards#driver-pay-and-incentives"],"recommendation":"Record a driver pay/incentive policy review and sign-off before launch."}]}
